name: Moss giants with adamant arrows (F2P)

name: Brutus with adamant arrows (F2P)

name: Chinning grey chinchompas at maniacal monkeys
note: Pay-to-play idealized rates assume best damage gear, Rigour, divine ranging potions, no downtime and 1,970 chinchompas/h as the page states; nonmax gear is 7-8% slower; monkeys drop 1-dose prayer potions.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Ranged training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged 2026-11-11

name: Chinning red chinchompas at maniacal monkeys
note: Pay-to-play idealized rates (1,970 chins/h, same assumptions as grey); the UIM guide's table at 1,866 chins/h with Eagle Eye or Deadeye is 55:412000,65:483000,75:555000,85:591000,95:663000,99:698000; the 70 Ranged red hunting ground needs the hard Western Provinces diary.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Ranged training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Ranged; Ironman Guide/Ranged 2026-11-11

name: Chinning black chinchompas at maniacal monkeys
note: Pay-to-play idealized rates (1,970 chins/h, same assumptions); the Ironman guide warns that without high stats and good defence, player killers are a much bigger threat when hunting black chinchompas.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Ranged training; Ironman Guide/Ranged 2026-11-11

name: Venator bow on maniacal or skeletal monkeys

source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Ranged training 2026-11-11 ; xp OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Ranged training 2026-11-11
